issues.legal_issue: Executing sale deeds conveying the vendors’ rights, title, and interest in disputed property does not constitute cheating of a third-party co-owner where the accused did not deceive that person or induce them to deliver or part with property.

Initiating criminal proceedings over a predominantly civil property-title dispute, while suppressing previously filed civil suits and doing so after a two-year delay, amounts to an abuse of the process of law.
